data.recorder: scripts/research/twapxyz_bbo_recorder.py (pid 14520, started 2026-10-05T07:40:53Z per recorder.log, --hours 75, end ~2026-10-08T10:40:53Z) -> data/raw/web/twapxyz/bbo_<YYYY-MM-DD-HH>.parquet (ts_us, coin, bid, ask, bid_sz, ask_sz, exch_ts_ms) and meta_<...>.parquet (5-min: growth_mode, fee_scale, funding, ...).
data.sampling: bbo is SAMPLED every 2 s; a row is written for a coin only if its bid or ask PRICE changed since its last row. A state at time t = last row with ts_us <= t. A coin with no new row is assumed unchanged (not a gap). Recorded sizes are the sizes at the moment of the written row; pure size changes are NOT written, so a recorded size can be arbitrarily stale while price is unchanged.
data.clock_rule: Local receive time ts_us only (exch_ts_ms runs ~2.6 s ahead; diagnostics only).

split.T0: 2026-10-05T07:40:53Z (twapxyz recorder.log 'start' line). Rows before T0 never exist/are never scored.
split.day1_train: [T0, T0+24h) = [2026-10-05T07:40:53Z, 2026-10-06T07:40:53Z): contains US session 2026-10-05 and KR session 2026-10-06. Kill test + all 12 configs; ONE config selected. Trades entered in day 1 whose exit would fall after T0+24h are closed by a taker exit at T0+24h (flagged), so no day-2 price is used in training.
split.day2_validation: [T0+24h, T0+48h) = [2026-10-06T07:40:53Z, 2026-10-07T07:40:53Z): US session 2026-10-06 + KR session 2026-10-07. The selected config only, run ONCE.

split.assignment: A trade belongs to the window containing its trigger time t.

data.gaps: Feed gap = any interval between a websocket disconnect/error line and the next 'ws connected' line in data/raw/web/twapxyz/recorder.log, plus 10 s after reconnect, plus any interval > 10 s in which NO coin of the 110 has a bbo row (global stall). No trigger whose [t - W, t_in] overlaps a gap; a position whose exit falls in a gap is closed at the first state after the gap (flagged).

rule.trigger: For each leader bbo row in an open session of that leader (decision time t = its ts_us), require t - W >= session open (the leader was open over the whole window). r_L = (mid_L(t)/mid_L(t-W) - 1) / lambda_L. Trigger if |r_L| >= theta; d = sign(r_L).
rule.follower_filter: For each follower paired with that leader in this session: r_F = (mid_F(t)/mid_F(t-W) - 1) / lambda_F; require d * r_F < theta/2. If several leaders trigger the same follower at the same t, it is one trigger (first row by ts_us).
rule.entry: Taker on the follower in direction d. Fill time t_in = t + 300 ms (L = 300 ms, our assumed order path; HL has no taker speed bump). Buy at the last recorded follower best ask with ts_us <= t_in, sell at best bid.
rule.exit: Exit decision at t_in + H; fill at t_out = t_in + H + 300 ms at the last recorded opposite best <= t_out. No stop, no session-end exit (the follower stays closed; leader session end does not change the follower).
rule.position_rules: one position per follower (across all leaders); cooldown H after the exit fill before a new entry on that follower.
rule.size: Target $1,000. Entry size = min($1,000, recorded opposite top-of-book notional at t_in). Skip (counted) if < $100. Exit: up to the recorded opposite top at t_out fills at that price; any excess fills one full spread (ask - bid at t_out) worse. ASSUMPTION stated now: recorded top sizes are those of the last price-change row (size-only updates are not recorded), so the size cap is approximate and may be stale in either direction.
rule.staleness_assumption: Because bbo is sampled every 2 s, the state 'at t_in' can be up to ~2 s older than t_in, and the trigger itself is only seen at the 2-s sample. Primary fill = last row <= t_in. A robustness line (REPORTED, never used for selection or the bar) fills entry and exit at the last row <= t + 2.3 s and <= t_in + H + 2.3 s (one full sampling period of extra delay).
rule.fees_per_side: 0.9 bp x (deployerFeeScale / 1.0) taker, only if the latest twapxyz meta snapshot with ts <= t_in shows growthMode 'enabled' and not delisted; otherwise the trigger is SKIPPED (counted). If no meta snapshot exists <= t_in, the first snapshot after T0 is used. At 2026-10-05T09:01Z all six names showed growthMode enabled, deployerFeeScale 1.0.
rule.funding: If the position is open at an HL hourly funding time (top of the UTC hour), pay/receive notional x funding rate from the latest twapxyz meta snapshot <= that time, by side (longs pay positive funding).
rule.pnl_unit: USD per round trip; bp = USD / entry notional x 1e4

kill_test_day1: Before any P&L: all day-1 triggers at theta = 10 bp, W = 60 s (no position rules, no cooldown, gaps excluded). Markout m = d x (mid_F(t + 5 min)/mid_F(t + 300 ms) - 1) in bp, mid-to-mid (before costs). If the mean m < 3 bp, OR fewer than 20 such triggers exist on day 1, H-CLOSEDPROXY is KILLED (fewer than 20 = killed for insufficient activity at the loosest threshold) and no config is selected. Also reported by session (US->KR followers vs KR->US followers) and by pair; diagnostic only.
selection_rule_day1: If the kill test passes: among configs with n >= 30 round trips on day 1 (pooled over pairs and both sessions), select the highest profit factor (ties: larger n). If none has net USD > 0 and PF > 1.0, H-CLOSEDPROXY is KILLED and day 2 is not run. The selected config must also be net > 0 with +0.5 bp extra cost per round trip, else take the next-best that is.
validation_day2: Selected config once on day 2. Bar: n >= 50, net USD > 0, PF > 1.2, net without the top-3 trades > 0. n < 50 = INCONCLUSIVE (not a pass); freeze anyway and continue forward (no re-selection) until n >= 50.

data_sufficiency.names_recorded: yes, all six (subscribed universe = all 110 non-delisted xyz coins).
data_sufficiency.sampling: 2-s sampling on price change: adequate for W = 60/300 s and H >= 1 min; it limits the 300 ms latency to a nominal value (see staleness_assumption).
data_sufficiency.size: bid_sz/ask_sz recorded but stale between price changes (assumption stated).
data_sufficiency.oracle: not tick-level (5-min meta only) -> the oraclePx leader dimension of the idea cannot be scored and was replaced.
data_sufficiency.beta: no pre-T0 history allowed -> beta dropped.
data_sufficiency.sessions: Each split day holds exactly one US and one KR session (~13 open-leader hours). With the lead's 10-30 triggers/day guess and cooldowns, day-2 n >= 50 is uncertain at theta = 20 bp; INCONCLUSIVE is a likely outcome. Forward after day 2 is ~1 more day (to ~2026-10-08T10:40Z) before the recorder stops.
